title: Interstellar
description: Christopher Nolan’s 2014 sci-fi epic Interstellar follows astronaut Cooper on a wormhole mission to save humanity from a dying Earth, merging cosmic adventure with heartfelt themes of love and time.

reviews.text: A breathtaking sci-fi masterpiece—stunning visuals, a haunting Zimmer score, and a deeply emotional core that makes cosmic exploration feel achingly human. Nolan balances grand scale with intimate heart perfectly.
Interstellar is more than a space epic; it’s a powerful meditation on love, sacrifice and time. Visually mesmerizing, emotionally resonant, and endlessly thought-provoking.
An extraordinary journey through space and time. The cinematography is stunning, and Hans Zimmer's soundtrack makes every moment unforgettable.
A visually spectacular and emotionally powerful film. Some scientific concepts are difficult to follow, but the story remains deeply engaging.

title: Inception
description: Christopher Nolan's 2010 sci-fi thriller about dreams within dreams.

reviews.text: Inception is a mind-bending sci-fi classic—twisty, visually stunning, and endlessly thought-provoking.
A brilliant and imaginative thriller with an incredibly clever concept. The dream sequences are fascinating, and the ending leaves you questioning reality.
The storyline is complex but rewarding. Excellent performances, impressive visual effects, and a memorable soundtrack make this film worth watching.
Christopher Nolan delivers an outstanding combination of science fiction, action, and psychological suspense. Every rewatch reveals something new.
An interesting and visually impressive film, although the complicated plot can sometimes make it difficult to connect with the characters.
